text:
Priya K.: SummitTech just pushed back — they need Private (VPC) + KMS/HSM + per-route latency SLO (100ms p95) for the Q3 go-live. They want a clear cutoff: either we land this by 2025-09-15 or they won't sign the dedicated contract. Can we map scope?
Olga (AE): Confirmed on call — they'd prefer Dedicated but will consider Hosted w/ private networking if we can provide the KMS tie-in and an SLA. They're sensitive to data residency too.
Anya (CSM): They flagged a compliance window tied to their audit: decision by 2025-08-01 to start validation. If we miss that, timeline slips to Q4.- they're pushing procurement deadlines.
Evan L.: From runtime side, KMS/HSM integration + audit logs is doable, but 100ms p95 across a private deployment with sequence lengths >1024 needs opt work (KV cache priming + batching policy). Rough estimate: 6 weeks for KMS + logs, 8-10 weeks for performance tuning + quant profiles.
Marco S.: Also need network egress topology for VPC peering. If we do dedicated pools in their region, cold-starts could bust p95 without prefix caching. Suggest gating by rollout criteria: p95 <120ms on canary, error rate <0.5%, audit log integrity tests pass.
Priya K.: Can we propose a reduced initial scope to hit the procurement date? e.g., M1: Private control plane + KMS + audit logs (no strict 100ms SLO, instead p95 baseline + optimization plan). M2: Full latency SLO and auto-scaling. That buys them compliance check-in.
Evan L.: Yes. Plan A (full): 10-12w; Plan B (phased): M1 = 4-6w (KMS + audit logs + network setup), M2 = +6w for perf. M1 acceptance: KMS integration end-to-end, audit export verification, and smoke test results.
Olga (AE): SummitTech will accept phased if we give a firm M1 delivery date and commit to M2 scope and cadence. They need a written acceptance criteria doc to share with procurement.
Priya K.: I'll draft acceptance criteria. Items to include: 1) KMS-backed keys in customer KMS, 2) Audit logs exported to S3 with encryption and retention 7y, 3) Network peering established, 4) Canary perf run with p95 baseline measured.
Marco S.: Add: runbook for incident escalation and observable traces (span ids tied to requests) — their security team insisted.
Anya (CSM): I'll confirm their exact data residency region and get the legal checklist.
Evan L.: Technical blockers: access to their KMS service account + HSM provisioning lead time. Recommend we request creds and a staging HSM slot within 3 business days after sign-off.
Priya K.: Decision needed: do we commit to M1 by 2025-08-01? If yes, we tell them M2 target 2025-09-15. If no, we risk slipping their contract.
Olga (AE): SummitTech terms: if we miss M1 deadline, they get a 3-month free extension on capacity pricing. They prefer firm dates.
Priya K.: Quick poll — thumbs up to commit to phased M1 by 2025-08-01?
Evan L.: :thumbsup: from infra, assuming we get staging access within 3 days.
Marco S.: :+1: need at least 2 engineers for 4 weeks.
Olga (AE): :thumbsup:
Anya (CSM): I'll schedule the follow-up call with their PM tomorrow 10am PST and get the KMS contact.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: private-kms-staging -> staging on 2025-06-12T03:00:00Z (CI: passed).
Priya K.: Great — I'll write the acceptance criteria doc and circulate. Filing action items: 1) Priya draft AC by EOD, 2) Anya confirm region and KMS contact, 3) Evan/Marco estimate exact engineer-days, 4) Olga update commercial terms. We'll reconvene after Anya's call.
Olga (AE): adding note — propose we include a 4-week canary with telemetry SLAs before M1 sign-off.
Evan L.: Agreed. Canary acceptance: p95 not worse than 1.3x baseline, errors <0.5% over 72h.
Priya K.: Copy — thanks team. I'll ping when doc is ready.
